benchmark_repo.purpose: reproducible end-of-turn policy benchmark over causal silence decisions

dataset.license_note: The pinned eot-bench README states the dataset is available 'Apache-2.0 alongside this repo', while the Hugging Face dataset metadata observed on 2026-08-30 reports cc-by-4.0. Preserve this provenance discrepancy; Trigger4 must bind the actual dataset revision and governing dataset license before copying or executing the corpus.

why_this_is_high_information: German is explicitly present in the shared multilingual corpus.
Every >=100 ms silence is evaluated causally: the final silence is EOT and earlier pauses are HOLD.
The benchmark exposes the production tradeoff directly as endpointing delay versus false-cutoff rate instead of a single classification accuracy.
A VAD-only baseline is evaluated on the same policy grid, enabling a fair test of whether NAMO adds value beyond silence timing.
It can become a common substrate for already-audited SmartTurn, NAMO and X2-Turn candidates instead of creating incomparable bespoke tests.

predeclared_component_comparison.baseline: same eot-bench German spans with silence/VAD-only policy
predeclared_component_comparison.candidate: same German spans with NAMO semantic EOU score/policy
predeclared_component_comparison.acceptance_rule: NAMO earns component value only if it improves the German latency/false-cutoff frontier over the identical VAD-only substrate without violating local resource limits.

execution_prerequisites: resolve and pin exact Hugging Face dataset revision
hash the consumed German dataset artifacts or an immutable local manifest
confirm dataset license/provenance at the consumed revision
bind exact NAMO model artifact already source-pinned
run through the admitted Trigger4/clay-direct-dev execution lane
persist exact command, environment, rows/spans consumed, predictions and output hashes
